description:
The Hedgehood OptionVault v2 funds (hhNVDA-CC, hhNVDA-WHEEL, hhGOOGL-CC, ...): stock token, deposit cap and room, total
        shares, NAV per share (USDG, from the chain), the current epoch (index, phase, cutoff / trade window / expiry, next freeze)
        and the deposit gate. Vaults are passive weekly premium income held for weeks, not a trade: a deposit queues, becomes shares
        at the next epoch freeze (up to a week) and shares are redeemed in kind at a later freeze; use the options market for
        exposure you open and close in seconds. Read-only; nothing is sent.
name: list_vaults
